news.headline: A Furry Swimmer From the Dinosaur Days
news.body: Scientists found the fossil of a furry, otter-like animal that swam in lakes and rivers in China about 165 million years ago. It is called Megacauda, and it had a wide, flat tail like a beaver's. It was about 20 inches long and probably caught fish while dinosaurs walked nearby!

news.headline: The World's Oldest Birthday Buddies
news.body: The two oldest men in the world share the very same birthday, October 5, but they were born one year apart. João lives in Brazil and just turned 114, and Ken lives in Australia and just turned 113. They sent each other happy birthday wishes from opposite sides of the world!

news.headline: A Space Picture Like a Fun-House Mirror
news.body: NASA shared a new picture from the James Webb Space Telescope of a giant group of galaxies. Their gravity is so strong that it bends the light from galaxies far behind them. That makes the faraway galaxies look stretched and copied, like reflections in fun-house mirrors!

fun_fact: Beavers have orange teeth! Their front teeth have iron in them, which makes them extra strong for chewing through wood. 🦫
